digest.component_or_area: reconciler outcome sealing and lifecycle versioning
propositions: Versioned lifecycle sections (intents, attempts, retry state, fuse state, pass tallies) must be additive and ignorable by older consumers while preserving existing mutation fields and canonical hash.

Cursor, baseline, binding, and last-pass state must advance only after proven postconditions; deferred, failed, skipped, and commit_unknown work must remain ineligible for advancement and eligible for re-observation.

The repair call binding_store.repair_at_write_boundary must execute after under-lock staleness validation and before the first remote issue fetch to prevent race conditions between durable retirement intent and fresh observation.
Mixed-pass tallies and exit semantics must be exact and account for applied/failed/deferred/skipped/recovered dispositions without miscounting.
Secrets must be redacted and all diagnostic fields and collections must be bounded in logs and manifests.
reconcile.py must remain within the 800-line cap without raising the limit during extraction of pre-observation repair logic.
